description: Schema contract: parse a REST create body with all four fields and assert exact retention; table-test malformed URL and malformed classification UUIDs, plus rejection of explicit null/empty values. Validate response-schema retention and existing update acceptance boundaries.

DB-backed shared-model happy path against migrated schema: seed same-tenant classification rows, call TicketModel.createTicket with all four fields, and query the stored ticket to assert exact equality. Run through real final validation and insert.

DB-backed shared-model compatibility: omit the four fields and assert null storage; also assert generated ticket identity/number, resolved default status, contact alias, assigned team, and description/attributes survive the mapping refactor.

DB-backed integrity guard: table-test each classification field with a UUID absent from the current tenant, including records present only in a second tenant; assert creation fails and the enclosing transaction leaves no ticket row.

HTTP API round trip against migrated DB: authenticated POST with URL and all three same-tenant UUIDs returns 201 and exact values; GET and a direct DB query agree. Then PUT a replacement URL and verify GET reflects it. Reuse the existing API harness and tenant-owned fixtures.

Compile-time mapping contract: type-check the exhaustive handling declaration; use a focused type assertion or negative compile fixture to prove that a new unhandled CreateTicketInput key fails and an unknown mapped input key fails. Confirm generated row fields cannot be supplied via arbitrary request keys in an executable mapping/schema assertion.

Generated OpenAPI contract: assert ticket-create properties include optional URL and three UUID fields with appropriate documentation; compare property formats to runtime request-schema cases without broad snapshot coverage.
